ledger.note: 1834: the Dutch conquer Berau and Sambaliung falls under Dutch overlordship. 'After the Dutch conquered Berau in 1834, they forced the sultan to sign an agreement on 27 September' (Bulungan page); the id.wikipedia Sambaliung article says only that the sultanate was once a protectorate of the Netherlands, undated. Recorded on the vassal's side. Reviewer note 2026-10-19: on the Bulungan page the sultan who signed on 27 September 1834 is Bulungan's; the page dates only the conquest of Berau to 1834. The dutch-east-indies dossier has no vassal_start for Sambaliung (only a 1849 gain at confidence 1).

notes: Page budget 2 (id.wikipedia Sambaliung, English Bulungan). The English titles Berau_Sultanate and Sambaliung_Sultanate returned URL_NOT_FOUND; the English page did not load, so the Indonesian article (Cliopatria's own Wikipedia field) is the source. (1) Life span: the page gives c. 1810 to 1960, Cliopatria 1830..1848; the row's end in 1848 is the Dutch East Indies row absorbing the land, see the Dutch East Indies dossier. (2) Territory and area are not on either page; the Cliopatria outline is carried unchanged and unverified. (3) States that need dossiers: Sultanate of Berau (before the split, with the vassalage of Bulungan 1731-1789 and the 1789 Sulu sack of Berau from the Bulungan page) and Sultanate of Gunung Tabur (the other half, c. 1810-1960). (4) Gazetteer names needed: Berau (region), Tanjung Redeb (place, about 117.49E 2.15N). (5) The vassal pair is recorded on the vassal's side with the Dutch East Indies as counterpart; the Dutch East Indies dossier has its own Berau handling (it dates the Dutch takeover 1849 from Cliopatria and cites 1834 from the Bulungan page). (6) Cliopatria's Sulu shape touches Sambaliung 1830-1848; the pages are silent on any Sulu claim there.
